description: This file contains functions and constants for managing session paths, directories, and files within a project, including resolving session directories, validating session IDs, and constructing file paths for session transcripts and data.

methods.name: resolveAgentSessionsDir
methods.description: Resolves the directory path for an agent's sessions based on agent ID, environment variables, and home directory.

methods.name: resolveSessionTranscriptsDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path for session transcripts for the default agent.

methods.name: resolveSessionTranscriptsDirForAgent
methods.description: Returns the directory path for session transcripts for a specified agent ID.

methods.name: resolveDefaultSessionStorePath
methods.description: Constructs the default file path for storing session data, typically 'sessions.json'.

methods.name: resolveSessionFilePathOptions
methods.description: Determines session file path options based on provided parameters, including agent ID and store path.

methods.name: validateSessionId
methods.description: Validates a session ID against a safe regex pattern.

methods.name: resolveSessionsDir
methods.description: Resolves the sessions directory path based on options or defaults.

methods.name: resolvePathFromAgentSessionsDir
methods.description: Resolves a candidate path relative to an agent's sessions directory, ensuring containment.

methods.name: resolveSiblingAgentSessionsDir
methods.description: Resolves a sibling sessions directory for a different agent based on a base sessions directory.

methods.name: resolveAgentSessionsPathParts
methods.description: Parses a session path to extract parts and index of 'sessions' directory.

methods.name: extractAgentIdFromAbsoluteSessionPath
methods.description: Extracts the agent ID from an absolute session path.

methods.name: resolveStructuralSessionFallbackPath
methods.description: Provides a fallback path for sessions based on expected agent ID and path structure.

methods.name: safeRealpathSync
methods.description: Safely resolves the real path of a file, returning undefined on error.

methods.name: resolvePathWithinSessionsDir
methods.description: Resolves a session file path within a sessions directory, handling relative and absolute paths.

methods.name: resolveSessionTranscriptPathInDir
methods.description: Constructs the path for a session transcript file within a directory, optionally including a topic ID.

methods.name: resolveSessionTranscriptPath
methods.description: Resolves the full path for a session transcript given session ID, agent ID, and optional topic ID.

methods.name: resolveSessionFilePath
methods.description: Resolves the full path for a session file, considering provided session entry and options.

methods.name: resolveStorePath
methods.description: Resolves the storage path for session data, supporting placeholders and home directory expansion.

methods.name: resolveAgentsDirFromSessionStorePath
methods.description: Derives the agents directory path from a session store file path.
